events.description: Setup of parallel input and output number lines with an arrow pointing from 0 to 1 labeled with e^x.
events.clip_query: Two parallel horizontal number lines, one on top and one on the bottom, with a diagonal arrow pointing from 0 on the top line to 1 on the bottom line, labeled e^x.

events.description: Lagged fade-in of yellow-to-blue gradient dots on the top line, followed by their transformation to the bottom line.
events.clip_query: A sequence of colored dots appearing on the top number line and then transforming into corresponding mapped dots on the bottom number line.

events.description: Transition to dynamic tracker mode with a dynamic arrow and an updating Tex label showing e^{+0.00} = 1.000.
events.clip_query: The static arrow and label are replaced by a dynamic arrow and a decimal label showing e to a power equals a value.

events.description: Flash effect around the active dots and introduction of static output labels for integer powers of e.
events.clip_query: A bright flash around a dot on the number line, followed by a curved animation path and static labels appearing above the bottom line.
